question: 'Maghi' is another name for which of the following festivals of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Makar Sankranti.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Maghi **is the regional name for the **Makar Sankranti** festival, celebrated in **Punjab**, **Haryana**, **Jammu **Division, and **Himachal **Pradesh.
 
• Makar Sankranti is a Hindu festival celebrated in **January (usually January 14** of the Gregorian calendar), marking the **transition of the sun into the zodiac sign of Makara (Capricorn).**
 
 
• It is always celebrated on the **first day of the month of Magha in the Vikrami calendar**.
 
 
 
• The festival is observed in different parts of India with various names such as **Pongal**, **Lohri**, **Uttarayan**, and Magh Bihu.</s
